**Guard the combined attachment count before moving attachments.**

Each transaction can validly contain up to 10 attachments. The merge then moves every pending attachment with `update_all`, so a merge such as 6 plus 5 creates 11 attachments without validation. A later transaction edit that submits `tag_ids` calls `@entry.transaction.save!`, which can raise `ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid` because `validate_attachments` sees the over-limit set.

Reject the merge before changing either transaction when the combined count exceeds the limit. This preserves the within-limit behavior from issue `#4220` and keeps the pending attachments intact.
